entries.definition: A small domesticated carnivore, or to search persistently; the word is not related to ferre.
entries.definitionCN: 一种小型家养食肉动物，或指持续搜寻；该词与 ferre 无关。

entries.definition: Producing a lot of goods, results or growth; it is the general word that fertile specifies for land and life.
entries.definitionCN: 产出大量货物、成果或增长；它是 fertile 用在土地与生命上的通用对应词。

entries.definition: Producing good results, especially in ideas or discussion; closer to the figurative fertile.
entries.definitionCN: 产生良好结果，尤指想法或讨论；更接近 fertile 的比喻义。

entries.definition: Abundant in resources or nutrients; it is wider than fertile and can describe wealth as well as soil.
entries.definitionCN: 资源或养分丰富；比 fertile 更宽，也可形容财富。

entries.definition: Producing many offspring, works or results; it stresses quantity rather than capacity.
entries.definitionCN: 产生许多后代、作品或成果；强调数量而非能力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real Latin verb, a real family and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、同族词与固定搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: fertile = fer- (to bear) + -ile (able): able to bear a great deal.
normal.cn: fertile = fer-（承载）+ -ile（能够）：能够承载很多。

normal.en: The same ferre runs through infer, transfer, refer and offer; each carries something somewhere.
normal.cn: 同一个 ferre 贯穿 infer、transfer、refer、offer；每个词都把某物带向某处。

normal.en: Fertile soil, fertile land and fertile ground are physical; fertile imagination is figurative.
normal.cn: fertile soil、fertile land、fertile ground 是物理用法，fertile imagination 是比喻用法。

normal.en: Futile is the opposite in sound and meaning: futile efforts bear nothing.
normal.cn: futile 在音与义上都相反：徒劳的努力什么也承载不出。

normal.en: In biology, fertile means able to reproduce; in nuclear physics, able to become fissile fuel.
normal.cn: 生物学中 fertile 指能繁殖；核物理中指能转化为裂变燃料。

abstract.en: A fertile mind is soil that keeps producing volunteers.
abstract.cn: 富于创造的心灵，是不断长出意外之苗的土壤。

abstract.en: Rumours need fertile ground more than they need proof.
abstract.cn: 谣言需要的是肥沃土壤，而不是证据。

abstract.en: The most fertile place is often the one that was flooded last.
abstract.cn: 最肥沃的地方，常常是上一次被洪水淹过的地方。

examples.en: The delta has some of the most fertile soil in the country.
examples.cn: 这片三角洲拥有全国最肥沃的一些土壤。

examples.en: Fertile eggs must be kept warm to develop.
examples.cn: 受精卵必须保持温暖才能发育。

examples.en: The internet proved fertile ground for the new movement.
examples.cn: 互联网成为这场新运动的温床。

dict_mnemonic.text: fertile 来自拉丁 ferre（承载）：能承载很多＝肥沃、能生育、多产；与 futile（徒劳）、ferrous（含铁）、feral（野生）形近而不同源。

root: 拉丁 fertilis「多产的」，由 ferre「承载、携带」加 -ilis「能够」构成；与 infer、transfer、refer 同出 ferre。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of fertile. The core is capacity to bear: soil bears crops, bodies bear offspring, minds bear ideas, ground bears rumours, and certain isotopes bear fuel.
sensesIntro.cn: fertile 的八个义项。核心是「承载的能力」：土壤承载作物，身体承载后代，头脑承载想法，地面承载谣言，某些同位素承载燃料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dark soil that crumbles in the hand and pushes up new shoots.
core.cn: 核心意象：在手中散开、能顶出新芽的黑土。

branches.en: THE GROUND: fertile soil, fertile land, and a field restored by fertiliser.
branches.cn: 土地：肥沃的土壤、富饶的土地，以及施肥后恢复肥力的田。

branches.en: LIFE THAT REPRODUCES: animals able to breed, then eggs and spores able to develop.
branches.cn: 能繁殖的生命：先是能生育的动物，再是能发育的卵与孢子。

branches.en: THE MIND AS SOIL: an imagination that keeps producing.
branches.cn: 作为土壤的心智：不断产出作品的想象力。

branches.en: GROUND FOR AN IDEA: a situation that lets something grow, often something unwanted.
branches.cn: 想法的温床：让某物（常为不受欢迎者）生长的环境。

branches.en: A TECHNICAL EXTENSION: a material able to become fuel.
branches.cn: 技术延伸：能转化为燃料的材料。

intro.en: Fertile divides as fert- plus -ile. The stem is Latin ferre 'to bear'; -ile is the Latin suffix meaning 'able to', so the adjective says able to bear.
intro.cn: fertile 可切分为 fert- 加 -ile。词干是拉丁 ferre「承载」；-ile 是拉丁后缀，意为「能够」，因此形容词意为「能承载的」。

latinIntro.en: Ferre gives a very large English family: infer, offer, prefer, refer, transfer, confer, differ and fertile. Fertility, fertilize and fertilizer are built on the adjective itself.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 衍生出庞大的英语词族：infer、offer、prefer、refer、transfer、confer、differ、fertile。fertility、fertilize、fertilizer 则由这个形容词本身派生。

items.example: Ferre is the source of transfer and refer.
items.exampleCN: ferre 是 transfer 与 refer 的来源。

items.example: Fertilis ager means a fruitful field.
items.exampleCN: fertilis ager 意为肥沃的田地。

items.example: Fertile, fragile and agile share the suffix.
Soil fertility depends on organic matter.
items.exampleCN: 土壤肥力取决于有机质。

items.meaning: to make fertile or to cause fertilisation
items.example: Bees fertilize the flowers.
The farmer spread fertilizer in spring.
Fertilization occurs inside the flower.

items.meaning: not able to bear or reproduce
items.example: The dry plateau is infertile.

items.meaning: the arc of fertile land in the Middle East
items.example: Wheat was first farmed in the Fertile Crescent.
items.exampleCN: 小麦最早在新月沃地种植。
